profile.name: Daravath Saathvik
profile.tagline: Game Designer | Crafting worlds players love and helping games find their audience | M.Des Digital Game Design, NID
profile.about:
I'm a game designer with a BA (Hons) in Game and Interactive Media Design from JNAFAU, currently pursuing a Master of Design in Digital Game Design at the National Institute of Design (NID).

I love blending creativity with design strategy to craft engaging player experiences. My background in digital marketing gives me an edge: I focus on understanding players, what they want, what excites them, and what keeps them coming back, and I use those insights to shape games that connect with their audience and stand out when they reach the market.
profile.summary:
Game designer pursuing a Master of Design (M.Des) in Digital Game Design at the National Institute of Design (NID), with a BA (Hons) in Game and Interactive Media Design from JNAFAU.

What sets me apart is how I bring marketing thinking into game development. At MaxLink Group of Companies, I managed nearly ₹1 crore in Meta and Google Ads spend at 5× ROAS and created static and video ad creatives in Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro. Today I apply that experience to understanding players, shaping games around what audiences want, and planning how a game gets discovered, marketed and sold.

experience.description:
Managed nearly ₹1 crore in paid media across Meta Ads and Google Ads, achieving 5× ROAS through data-led audience targeting, creative testing and budget optimisation.
Led full-funnel campaign strategy for CapShap, Yosha and Hudhawk, turning product launches and brand goals into conversion-focused digital campaigns.
Created performance-led static and video ad creatives in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro, tailored for Meta and Google placements.
Analysed campaign performance to refine targeting, messaging and creative direction, keeping acquisition aligned with profitable growth goals.

Designed high-impact static and video creatives for CapShap, Yosha and Hudhawk, maintaining a consistent visual identity across campaigns.
Produced paid-ad, social-media and promotional assets in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro, adapting each creative to its channel and audience.
Collaborated with marketing teams to turn campaign briefs into clear, conversion-focused visuals for product launches and brand promotions.
Iterated on creative concepts using campaign feedback, improving the relevance and effectiveness of visual communication across digital touchpoints.
